label: CalFresh FY2027 (Oct 1, 2026 – Sep 30, 2027)
about: Every number and threshold the GatorPlate rules engine uses, with its source. The engine reads all values from this file (no rule literals in code). Integers are whole dollars; strings are exact decimals (parse with Decimal, never float). Keys under value_sources name the source of each value (dotted paths for nested values). An estimate is never a decision: the county decides.

CDSS All County Letter 26-16: AB 42 (Chapter 430, Statutes of 2025), aid for higher education not counted as income (from 2026-03-01)
CDSS All County Letter 25-93: ABAWD time-limit changes under H.R. 1 (from 2026-06-01)

7 CFR Part 273 (SNAP certification): 273.1(b)(1)(ii) children under 22 living with a parent; 273.2(g) 30-day processing; 273.10(a)(1)(ii) first-month proration; 273.10(e)(2)(ii)(A) 30 percent reduction rounded up
7 CFR 271.2: definition of a homeless individual (includes a temporary stay of up to 90 days in another person's home)
CDSS Manual of Policies and Procedures 63-301.5 and 7 CFR 273.2(i): expedited service
Montana DPHHS SNAP Manual 201-1, Household Composition: a child under 22 living with a parent is in the parent's household even with their own spouse or child
Los Angeles County DPSS ePolicy, CalFresh application process: applications received after business hours, on weekends or on holidays are dated the next business day
SF State Basic Needs: CalFresh Help Clinic page
GatorPlate project rule (docs/SPEC.md, rules section): a deterministic convention or routing choice, not a CDSS rule
Common county practice not yet checked against a CDSS letter for this table: show dates from it as approximate

source_notes.grades: A = primary text read directly (CDSS letter, regulation). B = official secondary text (paraphrased regulations, county or campus page, another state's manual) or a regulation not re-read for this table. project = GatorPlate convention. unverified = not checked; never shown as exact.
source_notes.USDA-FNS-FY2027-COLA: The memo was not read directly (the download was refused); its date comes from a search-result excerpt. ACIN I-40-26 names the issuing USDA agency the Food and Nutrition Administration (FNA). No value in this table depends on the memo: every amount is taken from ACIN I-40-26, which releases the same values.
source_notes.ACL-15-42: The letter is dated April 15, 2015. ACIN I-40-26 cites it as issued April 15, 2016; the letter's own date is used here.
source_notes.7-CFR-273: Date = the day the text was checked. 273.1(b)(1)(ii), 273.10(a)(1)(ii) and 273.10(e)(2)(ii)(A) were read during the 2026-10-01 rules verification; 273.2(g) and 273.10(d)(1)(i) (an expense paid by someone else is not the household's deductible expense) were not re-read.
source_notes.7-CFR-271-2: Date = the day the definition was checked during the rules verification; not re-read for this table.
source_notes.MPP-63-301: Thresholds confirmed through a legal-aid summary of these rules during the 2026-10-01 verification; the regulation text was not saved with this table.
source_notes.MT-SNAP-201-1: Another state's manual, used only to confirm that the federal rule has no exception. Date = the day it was checked.
source_notes.LA-DPSS-CALFRESH-APPLICATION: Los Angeles County policy; San Francisco's practice was not confirmed. Date = the day the page was checked. The page is ePolicy, CalFresh, Application Process on the DPSS site: applications received on weekends, holidays or after business hours are post-dated to the next business day.
source_notes.SFSU-CALFRESH-CLINIC: Date = the day the page was checked. Its quick screen still lists FY2023 amounts and a 6-unit cutoff; this table uses the FY2027 amounts and the CalFresh half-time definition (see half_time.note).

household_size_lookup: Sizes 1 to 8 use their own row. Larger households: row 8 + each_over_8 x (size - 8). Where a table lists 18_plus, households of 18 or more use that amount instead. standard_deduction lists sizes 1 to 5 and 6_plus (6 or more people).
min_benefit_rule: Households of 1 or 2 people under the 200 percent gross test get at least min_benefit_1_2_persons, even when the computed amount is zero or below. There is no net income test.
zero_benefit_rule: A household of 3 or more whose computed amount is 0 or below gets no minimum: route zero_benefit_3_plus_route (the county decides). A positive computed amount below the minimum is kept as is.

homeless_rules.definition: No fixed nighttime residence, a shelter, or a temporary stay of at most homeless_temp_stay_max_days days in someone else's home.
homeless_rules.direct_if_cost: If the household pays some shelter cost, subtract homeless_shelter_deduction directly from adjusted income (no 50 percent test, no utility allowance). If actual shelter cost plus the utility allowance gives a larger excess-shelter deduction, use that instead. If the household pays nothing (free couch-surfing), there is no shelter deduction.
homeless_rules.excess_formula: Alternative mode kept only for tests: homeless_shelter_deduction is used as the shelter cost inside the excess-shelter formula. Not used for estimates.

utility_rules.from_slots: heat_cool = true gives heat_cool. Otherwise other_utils: two_plus gives two_other, phone_only gives phone_only, none gives none.
utility_rules.heat_cool: A heating or cooling bill paid separately from rent.
utility_rules.lua_utilities: At least two separate utility bills other than heating or cooling (for example electricity, water, sewer, garbage or phone); not a closed list; internet doesn't count. Electricity counts. ACIN I-40-26 gives the rule without a list; the paraphrased regulation (CDSS-SHD-270, rule effective 2006) names telephone, water, sewerage and garbage or trash as allowable utilities, and its list of shelter-cost utilities (heating and cooking fuel, cooling and electricity, water and sewerage, garbage and trash collection, the basic service of one telephone) has no internet service.
utility_rules.one_per_household: Only one allowance applies: the first of heat_cool, two_other, phone_only that fits.
utility_rules.shared_bills: GatorPlate applies the full allowance when the student pays the bill. Whether a bill shared with another household (for example, roommates who buy food separately) reduces the allowance is not settled by the sources checked: a 2016 paraphrase of ACL 02-55 says the allowance is prorated when utility costs are shared with another household. The county decides; the estimate may be high for a student who splits a heating bill.

conversion.round: Convert to monthly once and round to cents half-up; never round before the multiplication.

proration.below_min_issue: If the result is below proration_min_issue, the first month is 0.
proration.note: Prorate the minimum benefit itself, then apply the proration_min_issue rule. Engine golden cases pass apply_date explicitly; screens use filing_date_estimate.

expedited.shelter_test: gross + liquid < own shelter cost + utility allowance (strictly less)
expedited.rule: Expedited when (gross < income_lt and liquid <= liquid_le) or the shelter_test holds. Own shelter cost = rent share minus any part paid straight to the landlord by someone else; for a homeless household, the shelter cost it pays.
expedited.ask_cash_when: Ask the cash question (expedited.intro_cash) after a 'likely' result when gross < income_lt, or when own shelter cost + utility allowance > gross in any candidate world of the slots the student has not answered.

outlook.yes: expedited in every candidate world of the unanswered slots

irt_card_rule: Show the line 'report within deadlines.irt_report_days days if your household's income goes over {irt}' only when gross at the estimate <= irt_130 for the household size. Otherwise show 'no mid-period income report — report all income on your SAR 7'.
parent_household_console_text: Under 22 and living with a parent — the parent's household is counted together. Confirm, then help with a household application.

half_time.basis: Half of the units per term needed to graduate in four years (EDC 69519.3 as applied in ACL 24-31): a 120-unit SF State degree over 8 terms is 15 units a term, half is 7.5, so 8 units.
half_time.affects: Only the work-rule yellow line. Undergrad tier and amount never depend on units (at least half-time: degree programs qualify under ACL 26-25; under half-time: not a student for CalFresh).
half_time.grad: Half-time for a graduate program depends on the program; the county decides with the school. GatorPlate does not compute it from units: a grad student who takes fewer units than half-time says so through the under_half_time exemption choice.
half_time.note: The SF State CalFresh page's quick screen uses 6 units. GatorPlate uses the CalFresh definition above only for the work-rule yellow line, which a coordinator checks.

abawd.earnings_basis: Federal minimum wage 7.25 x 30 hours = 217.50 a week, x 4.33 = 941.775, rounded half-up to 941.78.
abawd.yellow_when: Under half-time AND age within abawd.age AND no child under abawd.child_exempt_under in the household AND monthly earnings < abawd.earnings_exempt_monthly AND not known to work abawd.work_requirement_hours_month hours a month or more (facts.works_80h_month false) AND not receiving unemployment benefits (facts.receives_unemployment false). facts.works_80h_month is true when the student says they work that many hours, or when their stated hours a week x conversion.multipliers.week reach it; facts.receives_unemployment is true when the student says they get unemployment benefits. Both default to false, so the yellow line is shown and a coordinator checks it.
abawd.yellow_text: Less than half-time: the county may apply the 3-month work rule unless the student works 80 hours a month.

exemption_labels.work20h: Paid work averaging 20 hours a week (80 a month)
exemption_labels.child_under_6: Cares for a child under 6 in the household
exemption_labels.child_6_to_11_no_care: Cares for a child 6 to 11 without adequate child care
exemption_labels.single_parent_full_time_child_under_12: Single parent, enrolled full-time, with a child under 12
exemption_labels.calworks: Gets CalWORKs or another TANF-funded benefit (including a TANF-funded Cal Grant A or B)
exemption_labels.dor_wioa: In a WIOA program, Department of Rehabilitation services, CalFresh Employment and Training, College Corps or LAEP

grad.rule: A graduate student at least half-time needs one exemption from the closed list; none gives coordinator.grad_no_exemption. The under_half_time choice means half_time = false: the student rule does not apply and the work-rule yellow line may. Age 50 or older and disability-based income are handled by age_coordinator and elderly_disabled.

status.rule: Only when the student volunteers it. The value and the quote are never stored; they only pick the route (other_help.status or coordinator.status_complex).

elderly_disabled.rule: Different gross and net tests, an uncapped shelter deduction and a medical deduction apply, so GatorPlate does not estimate.

excluded.work_study: State and federal work-study earnings are not counted.
excluded.higher_education_aid: Any grant, award, scholarship, fellowship or loan for attending college is not counted (from 2026-03-01).
excluded.vendor_payment: Money someone else pays straight to a landlord or creditor is not the student's income, and that part is not the student's shelter cost.

income_rules.counted_family_cash: Cash that family or friends give the student directly is counted as unearned income, even for school costs.
income_rules.self_employment: Self-employment or gig income: route coordinator.gig_income (costs and timing need a person).

decision_order.rule: Evaluated on a day (America/Los_Angeles) outside the effective dates: no estimate; route unresolved_tier (coordinator.unresolved), and the case gets the yellow line rules_not_valid.
status.other_help values give other_help.status; status.coordinator values give coordinator.status_complex.
Volunteered SSI/SSDI, other disability-based income or age 60+ gives coordinator.elderly_disabled.
Not an SF State student gives other_help.not_sfsu.

Under parent_household_age_under and living with a parent gives coordinator.parent_household, no exceptions. This household check runs before the student-age route, so a student under age_coordinator.under who lives with a parent gets coordinator.parent_household.
An undergrad or grad student under age_coordinator.under or at or over age_coordinator.at_or_over gives coordinator.age_outside_student_rule.
An undergrad not in an associate or bachelor's program at a CCC, CSU or UC (level not_degree, or public_ca_degree_program false) gives coordinator.not_degree.
A grad student at least half-time with no exemption gives coordinator.grad_no_exemption.
abawd.yellow_when sets the policy flag abawd.yellow_code (a yellow line, not a route).

A person under parent_household_age_under who lives with a parent was already routed at the parent_household step. In this order: buys and cooks with roommates gives coordinator.shared_household; boarder gives coordinator.boarder; spouse who is a student gives coordinator.spouse_student; on campus with more than dorm_meals_per_week_max_eligible meals a week gives other_help.dorm_meal_plan. Otherwise household size = the student + spouse + children.
Convert each amount to monthly (conversion, rounding.income_conversion). Drop income_rules.excluded amounts. Self-employment gives coordinator.gig_income. Gross = earned + unearned.
Gross > gross_limit_200 for the household size gives other_help.over_gross_limit (equal passes).
Gross - rates.earned_income_deduction x earned - standard_deduction - dependent care; not below 0.
Excess = own shelter cost + utility_allowance - rates.shelter_income_share x adjusted, between 0 and excess_shelter_cap_non_elderly_disabled. Homeless households: homeless_rules.
Adjusted - excess (or - homeless_shelter_deduction), not below 0, rounded once to the dollar half-up.

max_allotment - ceil(rates.benefit_reduction x net): the exact Decimal product rounded up to the whole dollar (rounding.benefit_reduction = dollar_ceil), with no numeric literal in code. rounding.benefit_reduction_integer_formula is only the independent test reference (N20), not the engine rule. Households of 1 or 2: at least min_benefit_1_2_persons. Households of 3+: 0 or below gives zero_benefit_3_plus_route.
proration with the filing date (engine tests: apply_date as given; screens: filing_date_estimate).
expedited.rule once cash on hand is known; null before.

deadlines.note: Dates in America/Los_Angeles. decision_days counts calendar days from the filing date; doc_request_days from the day the county asks for papers; irt_report_days from the day the income change is known. sar7_month and recert_month count months of the certification period, starting with the first benefit month. sar7_due_day and sar7_late_day are common county practice that was not checked for this table: show them as approximate ('around the 5th').

filing_date_estimate.rule: A weekday before 5 PM Pacific counts that day; otherwise the next weekday. Saturdays and Sundays are skipped; holidays are not modeled. Always labeled as an estimate.
filing_date_estimate.label: estimate
filing_date_estimate.note: Use the Pacific date, never the UTC date (5 PM PDT is already the next day in UTC). Engine golden cases carry apply_date explicitly; the pitch never states a first-month number.

default_mode_values.natural: each slot uses its own default below
default_mode_values.conservative: every slot uses its conservative value (the earlier rule)

voi.threshold_rule: Ask when the tier changes, or when the spread (highest minus lowest 'likely' amount, integer dollars) is strictly greater than flip_threshold_usd.
voi.measure: To measure one slot, hold every other open slot at its default (natural value, or conservative value when the default is 'conservative'), and compute the outcome for each candidate.
voi.conservative_value: The candidate with the lowest 'likely' amount; if none is 'likely', the first candidate.

rent_paid_by_others_to_landlord.follow_up_when: the answer is yes without an amount; the follow-up belongs to the same flip and does not count toward max_questions

voi.estimate_spoken: The amount with every open slot at its default.

estimate_range.lo_hi: Lowest and highest 'likely' amount over every candidate world of the slots the student has not answered (null until income and housing are known).
estimate_range.settled: True when no such world changes the tier and hi - lo <= flip_threshold_usd.

voi.flip_reason_text: could change the estimate by ${spread}: ${lo} or ${hi}

income_band.split_rule: Next closed question 'more or less than $X a month?' at the income where the estimate is halfway between the band ends, rounded to round_to_usd. If the band crosses the gross limit, ask at the limit first (a tier change comes first).
income_band.stop: Stop when the band's spread <= flip_threshold_usd or max_questions is reached; then assume the band top (the lower estimate) with a yellow line.

notes: ACIN I-40-26 lists a flat maximum allotment of $3,887 and an IRT of $12,197 for households of 18 or more; they are stored as 18_plus.
Rows 7 and 8 are stored as printed; the per-member increments apply only above 8 people.

Every value here was checked on 2026-10-01 against its cited source, or against the secondary text named in source_notes; values sourced to UNVERIFIED were not checked and are shown as approximate. The county makes every eligibility decision; GatorPlate only estimates.
